description: Set a product's prices in the workspace's additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies), e.g. [{currency: 'EUR', price: 4500, tiers: [{minQty: 10, price: 4000}]}]. Prices and breaks are minor units of each currency; nothing is converted from the default-currency price. price is read only while the product has no variants - a product with variants takes each variant's price from variants (here) and these tiers price every variant without breaks of its own in that currency (price null keeps just the tiers). variants sets each variant's prices per currency by its key (list_products variants[].key), e.g. [{variantKey, prices: [{currency: 'EUR', price: 4500}]}], and never touches stock, SKU or the default-currency price - this is the safe way to price variants per currency; prefer it over set_product_variants currencyPrices, which rewrites every variant's stock and SKU. A product with no price in a sales channel's currency is not sold on that channel (NO_PRICE_IN_CURRENCY). prices replaces the record's whole list: send every currency the product keeps. A variant removed while the call ran fails it with CONFLICT - re-read list_products and retry.

prices.description: The product's whole list of prices in additional currencies; it replaces what is stored, [] clears it. Each currency must be one of the workspace's additional currencies

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies)

price.description: The product's price in minor units of that currency (4900 = 49.00). Read only while the product has no variants; null holds just tiers that price its variants in that currency

tiers.description: Volume breaks in that currency, minor units; they also price every variant without breaks of its own in that currency. Omitted = none

minQty.description: Quantity at which this price starts applying (>= 2)

price.description: Unit price at this quantity, minor units (4900 = $49.00) - tiers are stored in minor units, unlike the base price field (major units)

variants.description: Per-variant prices in additional currencies, written in the same update as prices. Omit to leave every variant's prices untouched; a variant left out keeps its prices; a variant's prices: [] clears them. Never touches a variant's default-currency price, SKU or stock

prices.description: This variant's whole list of prices in additional currencies; it replaces the variant's list, [] clears it

currency.description: One of the workspace's additional currencies

price.description: The variant's price in minor units of that currency

tiers.description: The variant's own breaks in that currency; omitted or [] = the product's breaks in that currency (set_product_currency_prices)

minQty.description: Quantity at which this price starts applying (>= 2)

price.description: Unit price at this quantity, minor units (4900 = $49.00) - tiers are stored in minor units, unlike the base price field (major units)

variantKey.description: The variant's key: variants[].key from list_products, or variantKey from get_record variantCurrencyPrices

name: set_product_currency_prices
title: Set product currency prices
